tasks.label: DeskStream Release Build
args: $log='C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-build.log'; $out='C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-cargo-stdout.log'; $err='C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-cargo-stderr.log'; $p=Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Users\X1 CORBON\.cargo\bin\cargo.exe' -ArgumentList 'build','--release','--manifest-path','c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\Cargo.toml' -WorkingDirectory 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent' -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru; $p.WaitForExit(); Add-Content $log ('BUILD_EXIT_CODE='+$p.ExitCode); Add-Content $log ('BUILD_EXE_EXISTS='+$(if(Test-Path 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe'){'YES'}else{'NO'})); if(Test-Path 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe'){Add-Content $log ('BUILD_SHA256='+((Get-FileHash 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash))}; Add-Content $log ('BUILD_COMPLETE='+$(if($p.ExitCode -eq 0 -and (Test-Path 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe')){'YES'}else{'NO'}))

tasks.label: DeskStream Release Build Corrected
args: $log='C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-build.log'; $out='C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-cargo-stdout.log'; $err='C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-cargo-stderr.log'; Set-Content $out ''; Set-Content $err ''; $p=Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Users\X1 CORBON\.cargo\bin\cargo.exe' -ArgumentList 'build','--release' -WorkingDirectory 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent' -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru; $p.WaitForExit(); Add-Content $log ('BUILD_EXIT_CODE='+$p.ExitCode); Add-Content $log ('BUILD_EXE_EXISTS='+$(if(Test-Path 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe'){'YES'}else{'NO'})); if(Test-Path 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe'){Add-Content $log ('BUILD_SHA256='+((Get-FileHash 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash))}; Add-Content $log ('BUILD_COMPLETE='+$(if($p.ExitCode -eq 0 -and (Test-Path 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe')){'YES'}else{'NO'}))

tasks.label: DeskStream Direct Cargo Build
args: Set-Location 'c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent'; & 'C:\Users\X1 CORBON\.cargo\bin\cargo.exe' build --release *> 'C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-cargo-direct.log'; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Add-Content 'C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-build.log' ('DIRECT_BUILD_EXIT_CODE='+$code); Add-Content 'C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-build.log' ('DIRECT_BUILD_EXE_EXISTS='+$(if(Test-Path 'target\release\desktop-agent.exe'){'YES'}else{'NO'})); if(Test-Path 'target\release\desktop-agent.exe'){Add-Content 'C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-build.log' ('DIRECT_BUILD_SHA256='+((Get-FileHash 'target\release\desktop-agent.exe' -Algorithm SHA256).Hash))}; Add-Content 'C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-build.log' ('DIRECT_BUILD_COMPLETE='+$(if($code -eq 0 -and (Test-Path 'target\release\desktop-agent.exe')){'YES'}else{'NO'}))

tasks.label: DeskStream Artifact Evidence
args: $source='c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe'; Write-Output ('SOURCE_EXISTS='+$(if(Test-Path $source){'YES'}else{'NO'})); if(Test-Path $source){$i=Get-Item $source; Write-Output ('SOURCE_SIZE='+$i.Length); Write-Output ('SOURCE_TIMESTAMP='+$i.LastWriteTime.ToString('o')); Write-Output ('SOURCE_SHA256='+((Get-FileHash $source -Algorithm SHA256).Hash))}; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'Name=''desktop-agent.exe''' | Select-Object ProcessId,ExecutablePath,CommandLine; netstat -ano | findstr ':49182 :49183 :49184'

tasks.label: DeskStream Installed Hash
args: $installed='C:\Program Files\Screen Share\desktop-agent.exe'; Write-Output ('INSTALLED_EXISTS='+$(if(Test-Path $installed){'YES'}else{'NO'})); if(Test-Path $installed){$i=Get-Item $installed; Write-Output ('INSTALLED_SIZE='+$i.Length); Write-Output ('INSTALLED_TIMESTAMP='+$i.LastWriteTime.ToString('o')); Write-Output ('INSTALLED_SHA256='+((Get-FileHash $installed -Algorithm SHA256).Hash))}

tasks.label: Diagnose Protected Agent
args: $p=Get-Process -Id 28784 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($p){Write-Output ('PROCESS_NAME='+$p.ProcessName); Write-Output ('PROCESS_ID='+$p.Id); Write-Output ('PROCESS_START='+$p.StartTime.ToString('o'))}; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=28784' | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine,ParentProcessId | Format-List; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 49182,49183,49184 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort,State,OwningProcess,RemoteAddress,RemotePort | Format-Table -AutoSize; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'Name=''desktop-agent.exe''' | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath,CommandLine

tasks.label: Inspect Agent Parent
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=7712' | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine,ParentProcessId | Format-List; Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.TaskName -match 'Screen|Share|Desk|Agent'} | Select-Object TaskName,TaskPath,State | Format-Table -AutoSize; Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run','HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List

tasks.label: Inspect Agent Task Details
args: Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Get-ScheduledTaskInfo | Format-List; Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Actions | Format-List; Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Triggers | Format-List

tasks.label: Stop DeskStream Autostart
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Stop-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Stop-Process -Id 28784 -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700; Write-Output ('REMAINING_AGENTS='+@((Get-Process -Name 'desktop-agent' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)).Count); netstat -ano | findstr ':49182 :49183 :49184'

tasks.label: Persist SpaceAgent Diagnosis
args: $log='C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-spaceagent-diagnosis.log'; Set-Content $log ('DIAGNOSIS_TIME='+[DateTime]::Now.ToString('o')); Add-Content $log '=== TASK ==='; Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List * | Out-File $log -Append; Add-Content $log '=== TASK INFO ==='; Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List * | Out-File $log -Append; Add-Content $log '=== ACTIONS ==='; (Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Actions | Format-List * | Out-File $log -Append; Add-Content $log '=== PID ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=28784' | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | Format-List | Out-File $log -Append; Add-Content $log '=== PARENT ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=7712' | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | Format-List | Out-File $log -Append; Write-Output 'DIAGNOSIS_WRITTEN=YES'

tasks.label: End DeskStream Task Instance
args: schtasks /end /tn SpaceAgentTask & echo SCHTASKS_EXIT=%ERRORLEVEL% & tasklist /fi "PID eq 28784"

tasks.label: Elevated Stop Protected Agent
args: schtasks /create /tn DeskStreamTempStop /tr "cmd.exe /c taskkill /PID 28784 /F" /sc once /st 23:59 /ru SYSTEM /f && schtasks /run /tn DeskStreamTempStop && timeout /t 3 /nobreak >nul && tasklist /fi "PID eq 28784" && schtasks /delete /tn DeskStreamTempStop /f

tasks.label: Capture Process Blocker Evidence
args: $log='C:\Users\Public\DeskStream-process-blocker.log'; $lines=[System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new(); $lines.Add('DESKSTREAM PROCESS BLOCKER DIAGNOSIS '+[DateTime]::Now.ToString('o')); $lines.Add('=== PROCESS ==='); $lines.Add((Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=28784' | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | Out-String)); $lines.Add('=== USER ==='); $lines.Add((Get-Process -Id 28784 -IncludeUserName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,UserName,Path,StartTime | Out-String)); $task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $lines.Add('=== TASK ==='); $lines.Add(($task | Format-List * | Out-String)); $lines.Add('=== ACTIONS ==='); $lines.Add(($task.Actions | Format-List * | Out-String)); $lines.Add('=== TRIGGERS ==='); $lines.Add(($task.Triggers | Format-List * | Out-String)); $lines.Add('=== INFO ==='); $lines.Add((Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List * | Out-String)); $lines.Add('=== PARENT ==='); $parent=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=28784').ParentProcessId; $lines.Add((Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"ProcessId=$parent\" | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | Format-List | Out-String)); $lines.Add('=== SERVICES ==='); $lines.Add((Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'Space|DeskStream|ScreenShare|desktop' -or $_.DisplayName -match 'Space|DeskStream|ScreenShare|desktop'} | Format-List Name,DisplayName,Status,StartType | Out-String)); $lines.Add('=== COPIES ==='); Get-ChildItem -Path 'C:\Program Files','C:\Users' -Filter 'desktop-agent.exe' -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {$h=(Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; $lines.Add(\"$($_.FullName) size=$($_.Length) modified=$($_.LastWriteTime.ToString('o')) sha256=$h\")}; Set-Content -Path $log -Value $lines -Encoding utf8; Write-Output 'DIAGNOSIS_WRITTEN=YES'

tasks.label: Point DeskStream Task To Installed
args: $task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\' -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -ErrorAction Stop; $action=New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'C:\Program Files\Screen Share\desktop-agent.exe' -WorkingDirectory 'C:\Program Files\Screen Share'; Set-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\' -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask' -Action $action -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; (Get-ScheduledTask -TaskPath '\' -TaskName 'SpaceAgentTask').Actions | Select-Object Execute,Arguments,WorkingDirectory | Format-List

tasks.label: Install Built Agent Binary
args: $source='c:\xampp\htdocs\Screen Share\desktop-agent\target\release\desktop-agent.exe'; $target='C:\Program Files\Screen Share\desktop-agent.exe'; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $source -Destination $target -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('INSTALLED_SHA256='+((Get-FileHash $target -Algorithm SHA256).Hash))
